title: 💻 Gemini Runs Your Mac for You!
body: 💻 Gemini Runs Your Mac for You!
Google announced that its “computer use” feature has arrived in the Gemini app on Mac, so the assistant now carries out multi-step tasks by itself.
Gemini moves between your files, apps, and websites in the background, inside an isolated window, with a live preview inside the chat so you can see what it is doing moment by moment.
The feature is rolling out gradually in English in the US first, and requires a paid subscription to Google’s AI plans.
Would you let a smart assistant control your computer? And what are your limits with it?
